text_annotations.text: Q1004 pins: 1=E 2=C 3=B (BD139). Bridged jumpers sit on the diagonal; for a B-C-E part (TIP41C) move the bridges of pad 1 and pad 3.
Q2004 pins: 1=E 2=C 3=B (BD139). Bridged jumpers sit on the diagonal; for a B-C-E part (TIP41C) move the bridges of pad 1 and pad 3.
Shared: DC in, reservoir, input header (L G R), speaker terminals. Test points TP1 +12V, TP2 GND.

observations: +12V: highest SRF is 22.51 MHz — consider adding small (100pF-1nF) MLCC for >100 MHz coverage
Low assembly complexity (score 33/100) — hand assembly feasible
